verdict.rationale: Make documents a resource-oriented REST API (with a TypeScript SDK) that can list connections and access data stores, and its MCP server can view scenarios and related entities like data stores. A user could likely pull account data out programmatically, but nothing in the pack describes a dedicated export feature or a portable open format. Missing for 10: documented bulk or full-account export, explicit open or portable export formats (e.g. scenario blueprints as JSON, data store CSV), account-deletion and offboarding guidance, independent corroboration.
